2026 General Election

General Election

Election Day is Tuesday, November 3, 2026
Polls are open 7:00 am to 7:00 pm

Ways to Vote

  • Vote-by-Mail
  • Early Voting
  • Election Day

Visit the Upcoming Elections page for important election dates and deadlines.

Vote-by-Mail Ballot Drop Off Locations

Vote-by-Mail ballots may be dropped off at any Early Voting location during Early Voting hours, at a Secure Ballot Intake Station, or one of our four offices during office hours. 

Vote-by-Mail ballots must be received by 7:00 pm at our Main Office, or by 5:00 pm at one of our branch offices, on Election Day, Tuesday, November 3, 2026, in order to be counted. 

Early Voting Location Hours

  • October 19 through November 1, 2026: 7:00 am to 7:00 pm

Secure Ballot Intake Stations (SBIS)

Main Office SBIS Drop Off Hours: 

  • October 19 - November 3, from 7:00 am to 7:00 pm

Branch Office SBIS Drop Off Hours: 

  • October 19 - October 23, from 8:30 am to 5:00 pm
  • October 26 - October 30, from 8:30 am to 5:00 pm
  • November 2, from 8:30 am to 5:00 pm
  • November 3, from 7:00 am to 5:00 pm

Vote-by-Mail ballots may not be dropped off at an Election Day polling place; your Vote-by-Mail ballot will be cancelled and you will be provided with a regular ballot to vote at your polling place. 

Important Alert

Stay Election Ready when you renew your Florida Driver License or State ID. Driver Licenses and IDs issued since July 31, 2024, have been assigned new numbers. If you have received a new Driver License or State ID since July 31, 2024, please update your voter information to include your new number to ensure our office has the most current information on file. Voters are encouraged to keep their voter information up-to-date online at RegisterToVoteFlorida.gov or by contacting our office.
